## Statements

- Stated by harness (goose-cli-commands, line 403-461, run, Input, Session, and Control Options): Run goose headless with goose run -t or -i FILE; add --no-session to skip session storage and -q to print only the model reply.
- Stated by harness (goose-providers, line 620-636, Pointing at a LiteLLM proxy; line 594-599, GOOSE_MODEL): The OpenAI provider reaches any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through OPENAI_HOST and OPENAI_BASE_PATH; GOOSE_MODEL names the model. A 404 usually means a wrong base path.
- Stated by harness (goose-cli-commands, line 452-455, run, Control Options): goose run allows 1000 turns without user input by default; lower it with --max-turns, and cap repeated identical tool calls with --max-tool-repetitions.
